sentences.zh: 占悉同上。

translations.literal: All prognostications were the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostications matched those above.

sentences.zh: 是時公孫淵自立為燕王，署置百官，發兵距守，遣司馬懿討滅之。

translations.literal: At that time Gongsun Yuan declared himself King of Yan, appointed the hundred officials, raised troops to hold out in defense; Sima Yi was sent to attack and destroy him.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsun Yuan had declared himself King of Yan, installed a full court, and mobilized for defense until Sima Yi was sent and destroyed him.

sentences.zh: 青龍三年十二月戊辰，月犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: Qinglong year 3, twelfth month, day wuchen: the moon encroached on Hooked Halberd.
translations.idiomatic: Qinglong 3, twelfth month, day wuchen: the moon crossed Hooked Halberd.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「王者憂。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The king has anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The ruler faces disaster.

sentences.zh: 」景初三年正月，明帝崩。

translations.literal: " Jingchu year 3, first month, Emperor Ming died.
translations.idiomatic: " Jingchu 3, first month: Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 青龍四年五月壬寅，太白犯畢左股第一星。

translations.literal: Qinglong year 4, fifth month, day renyin: Great White encroached on the first star of Net's left thigh.
translations.idiomatic: Qinglong 4, fifth month, day renyin: Venus crossed the first star of Net's left thigh.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「畢為邊兵，又主刑罰。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Net is border warfare; it also governs punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Net governs frontier warfare and punishment.

sentences.zh: 」九月，涼州塞外胡阿畢師侵犯諸國，西域校尉張就討之，斬首捕虜萬許人。

translations.literal: " Ninth month, the frontier non-Han Abi Shi of Liangzhou beyond the passes raided the various states; Protector of the Western Regions Zhang Jiu attacked him, beheading and capturing prisoners numbering about ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month the Liangzhou tribesman Abi Shi raided the western kingdoms; Protector of the Western Regions Zhang Jiu crushed him, killing or capturing some ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 青龍四年七月甲寅，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: Qinglong year 4, seventh month, day jiayin: Great White encroached on the great star of Chariot Pivot.
translations.idiomatic: Qinglong 4, seventh month, day jiayin: Venus crossed the great star of Chariot Pivot.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「女主憂。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The chief consort has anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The empress faces danger.

sentences.zh: 」景初元年，皇后毛氏崩。

translations.literal: " Jingchu year 1, Empress Mao died.
translations.idiomatic: " Jingchu 1: Empress Mao died.

sentences.zh: 青龍四年十月甲申，有星孛於大辰，長三尺。

translations.literal: Qinglong year 4, tenth month, day jiashen: a broom star appeared at Great Aries, three chi long.
translations.idiomatic: Qinglong 4, tenth month, day jiashen: a comet appeared at Great Aries, three feet long.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，又孛於東方。

translations.literal: Day yiyou, again a broom star in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Day yiyou: another comet appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，彗星見，犯宦者天紀星。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jihai: a comet appeared, encroaching on Eunuchs Celestial Regulation star.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, day jihai: a comet appeared crossing the Eunuchs star of Celestial Regulation.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大辰為天王，天下有喪。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Great Aries is the celestial king; all under Heaven has mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Great Aries is the celestial king—mourning falls on the realm.

sentences.zh: 」劉向《五紀論》曰：「《春秋》星孛於東方，不言宿者，不加宿也。

translations.literal: " Liu Xiang's Five Regulators Treatise says: "In the Spring and Autumn Annals when a broom star is in the east, it does not name the lodge—the lodge is not specified.
translations.idiomatic: " Liu Xiang's Five Regulators Treatise notes: "When the Spring and Autumn Annals records a comet in the east without naming its lodge, it means the lodge was not yet fixed.

sentences.zh: 」宦者在天市為中外有兵，天紀為地震。

translations.literal: " Eunuchs in Celestial Market presage warfare at court and in the provinces; Celestial Regulation presages earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: " The Eunuchs star in Celestial Market foretells armies at court and abroad; Celestial Regulation foretells earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 孛彗主兵喪。

translations.literal: Broom stars and comets govern warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Comets presage war and mourning.

sentences.zh: 景初元年六月，地震。

translations.literal: Jingchu year 1, sixth month, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchu 1, sixth month: an earthquake struck.

sentences.zh: 九月，吳將硃然圍江夏，荊州刺史胡質擊走之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, Wu general Zhu Ran besieged Jiangxia; Inspector of Jing Province Hu Zhi attacked and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Wu general Zhu Ran besieged Jiangxia; Jing's provincial inspector Hu Zhi repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 皇后毛氏崩。

translations.literal: Empress Mao died.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Mao died.

sentences.zh: 二年正月，討公孫淵。

translations.literal: Year 2, first month, Gongsun Yuan was attacked.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchu 2, first month: the court marched against Gongsun Yuan.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，明帝崩。

translations.literal: Year 3, first month, Emperor Ming died.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchu 3, first month: Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 景初二年二月癸丑，月犯心距星，又犯中央大星。

translations.literal: Jingchu year 2, second month, day guichou: the moon encroached on Heart's margin star, and again encroached on the central great star.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchu 2, second month, day guichou: the moon crossed Heart's margin star and then crossed its central great star.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥，又犯心距星及中央大星。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jihai, again encroached on Heart's margin star and the central great star.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, day jihai: it crossed Heart's margin star and central great star again.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸丑，月又犯心、中央大星。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, day guichou, the moon again encroached on Heart and the central great star.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, day guichou: the moon again crossed Heart and its central great star.

sentences.zh: 按占，「大星為天王，前為太子，後為皇子。

translations.literal: Checking the prognostications: "The great star is the celestial king; the star before it is the heir apparent; the star behind is a prince.
translations.idiomatic: Per the prognostications: "The central star is the celestial king; the star in front is the crown prince; the star behind is an imperial son.

sentences.zh: 犯大星，王者惡之。

translations.literal: Encroaching on the great star—rulers dread it.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the great star—rulers dread it.

sentences.zh: 犯前星，太子有憂。

translations.literal: Encroaching on the front star—the heir apparent has anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the front star—the crown prince faces danger.

sentences.zh: 犯後星，庶子有憂。

translations.literal: Encroaching on the rear star—lesser sons have anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the rear star—imperial sons face danger.

sentences.zh: 」三年正月，帝崩，太子立，卒見廢為齊王。

translations.literal: " Year 3, first month, the emperor died; the heir apparent was enthroned, but in the end was deposed as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: " Jingchu 3, first month: the emperor died and the crown prince took the throne, only to be deposed as Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 正始四年，秦王詢薨。

translations.literal: Zhengshi year 4, Prince of Qin Xun died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengshi 4: Prince of Qin Xun died.

sentences.zh: 景初二年八月彗星見張，長三尺，逆西行，四十一日滅。

translations.literal: Jingchu year 2, eighth month: a comet appeared in Extended Net, three chi long, traveling west against the stars, extinguished after forty-one days.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchu 2, eighth month: a comet appeared in Extended Net, three feet long, moving retrograde westward; it faded after forty-one days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為兵喪。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "It presages warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "War and mourning follow.

sentences.zh: 張，周分野，洛邑惡之。

translations.literal: Extended Net is Zhou's allotted field—Luoyang is imperiled.
translations.idiomatic: Extended Net marks Zhou's domain—Luoyang bears the omen.

sentences.zh: 」其十月，斬公孫淵。

translations.literal: " That tenth month, Gongsun Yuan was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: " That tenth month Gongsun Yuan was executed.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，明帝崩。

translations.literal: The next year, first month, Emperor Ming died.
translations.idiomatic: The following first month Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 景初二年十月甲午，月犯箕。

translations.literal: Jingchu year 2, tenth month, day jiawu: the moon encroached on Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchu 2, tenth month, day jiawu: the moon crossed Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「軍將死。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Army generals die.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "An army commander will die.

sentences.zh: 」正始元年四月，車騎將軍黃權薨。

translations.literal: " Zhengshi year 1, fourth month, General of Chariots and Cavalry Huang Quan died.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhengshi 1, fourth month: General of Chariots and Cavalry Huang Quan died.

sentences.zh: 景初二年，司馬懿圍公孫淵于襄平。

translations.literal: Jingchu year 2, Sima Yi besieged Gongsun Yuan at Xiangping.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchu 2: Sima Yi besieged Gongsun Yuan at Xiangping.

sentences.zh: 八月丙寅夜，有大流星長數十丈，色白有芒鬣，從首山北流墜襄平城東南。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day bingyin, night: there was a great meteor tens of zhang long, white with horned rays, flowing north from Shoushan and falling southeast of Xiangping city.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the eighth month's day bingyin a great meteor tens of fathoms long—white, with blazing rays—swept north from Mount Shou and fell southeast of Xiangping.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「圍城而有流星來走城上及墜城中者破。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "When a city is besieged, if a meteor comes running over the wall or falls within the city, the city is broken.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "When a city is under siege, a meteor racing over its walls or falling inside means the city will fall.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「星墜，當其下有戰場。

translations.literal: " It also says: "When a star falls, beneath it there will be a battlefield.
translations.idiomatic: " Also: "Where a star falls, a battlefield lies below.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「凡星所墜，國易姓。

translations.literal: " It also says: "Whenever a star falls, the state's surname is changed.
translations.idiomatic: " Also: "Wherever a star falls, a dynasty changes hands.

sentences.zh: 」九月，淵突圍，走至星墜所被斬，屠城坑其眾。

translations.literal: " Ninth month, Yuan broke the siege and fled to where the star had fallen, where he was beheaded; the city was slaughtered and its people buried alive in pits.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month Yuan broke out, fled to the place where the star had fallen, and was killed; the city was sacked and its people put to the sword and buried in mass graves.

sentences.zh: 景初二年十月癸巳，客星見危，逆行在離宮北，騰蛇南。

translations.literal: Jingchu year 2, tenth month, day guisi: a guest star appeared in Rooftop, moving retrograde north of Retirement Palace, south of Coiled Serpent.
translations.idiomatic: Jingchu 2, tenth month, day guisi: a guest star appeared in Rooftop, moving retrograde between Retirement Palace to the north and Coiled Serpent to the south.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，犯宗星。

translations.literal: Day jiachen, it encroached on the Ancestor star.
translations.idiomatic: Day jiachen: it crossed the Ancestor star.

sentences.zh: 己酉，滅。

translations.literal: Day jiyou, it was extinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Day jiyou: it vanished.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「客星所出有兵喪。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Where a guest star appears, there is warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Where a guest star appears, war and mourning follow.

sentences.zh: 虛危為宗廟，又為墳墓。

translations.literal: Emptiness and Rooftop are the ancestral temple; they also signify graves.
translations.idiomatic: Emptiness and Rooftop govern the ancestral temple—and also tombs.

sentences.zh: 客星近離宮，則宮中將有大喪，就先君於宗廟，皆王者崩殞之象也。

translations.literal: A guest star near Retirement Palace means the palace will soon have great mourning, paying respects to former rulers at the ancestral temple—all signs of a king's death.
translations.idiomatic: A guest star near Retirement Palace foretells great mourning within the palace and rites for departed sovereigns at the ancestral temple—all omens of royal death.

sentences.zh: 」三年正月，明帝崩。

translations.literal: " Year 3, first month, Emperor Ming died.
translations.idiomatic: " Jingchu 3, first month: Emperor Ming died.

sentences.zh: 正始二年五月，吳將硃然圍樊城，司馬懿率眾距卻之。

translations.literal: Zhengshi year 2, fifth month, Wu general Zhu Ran besieged Fancheng; Sima Yi led troops to repel and drive him back.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengshi 2, fifth month: Wu general Zhu Ran besieged Fancheng; Sima Yi led an army and repulsed him.

sentences.zh: 正始二年九月癸酉，月犯輿鬼西北星。

translations.literal: Zhengshi year 2, ninth month, day guiyou: the moon encroached on the northwest star of Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengshi 2, ninth month, day guiyou: the moon crossed the northwest star of Ghost.

sentences.zh: 西北星主金。

translations.literal: The northwest star governs metal.
translations.idiomatic: The northwest star governs gold.

sentences.zh: 三年二月丁未，又犯西南星。

translations.literal: Year 3, second month, day dingwei, again encroached on the southwest star.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengshi 3, second month, day dingwei: it crossed the southwest star again.

sentences.zh: 西南星主布帛。

translations.literal: The southwest star governs cloth and silk.
translations.idiomatic: The southwest star governs cloth and silks.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有錢令。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "There is an order concerning money.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "A monetary edict will issue.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「大臣憂。

translations.literal: " One reading says: "Great ministers have anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: " Alternatively: "Grand ministers face danger.

sentences.zh: 」三年三月，太尉滿寵薨。

translations.literal: " Year 3, third month, Grand Commandant Man Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhengshi 3, third month: Grand Commandant Man Chong died.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，帝加元服，賜群臣錢各有差。

translations.literal: Year 4, first month, the emperor received the capping ceremony; cash was bestowed on the ministers, each in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengshi 4, first month: the emperor came of age, and the court granted cash to the ministers in varying sums.

sentences.zh: 正始九年七月癸丑，鎮星犯楗閉。

translations.literal: Zhengshi year 9, seventh month, day guichou: Quelling Star encroached on Door Bolt.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengshi 9, seventh month, day guichou: Saturn crossed Door Bolt.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「王者不宜出宮下殿。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The king ought not leave the palace or descend from the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The sovereign should not leave the palace or step down from the throne hall.

sentences.zh: 」明年，車駕謁陵，司馬懿奏誅曹爽等，天子野宿，於是失勢。

translations.literal: " The next year, the imperial carriage visited the tombs; Sima Yi memorialized to execute Cao Shuang and others; the Son of Heaven lodged in the open wilds, and thus lost power.
translations.idiomatic: " The next year the emperor went to pay respects at the tombs; Sima Yi moved to execute Cao Shuang and his faction; the emperor camped in the open—and from that moment lost all real power.

sentences.zh: 魏齊王嘉平二年十月丙申，月犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Wei, Prince of Qi, Jiaping year 2, tenth month, day bingshen: the moon encroached on Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wei emperor Cao Fang, Jiaping 2, tenth month, day bingshen: the moon crossed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國有憂。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The state has anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The realm faces trouble.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「大臣憂。

translations.literal: " One reading says: "Great ministers have anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: " Alternatively: "Grand ministers face danger.

sentences.zh: 」三年四月戊寅，月犯東井。

translations.literal: " Year 3, fourth month, day wuyin, the moon encroached on Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: " Jiaping 3, fourth month, day wuyin: the moon crossed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「軍將死。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Army generals die.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "An army commander will die.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「國有憂。

translations.literal: " One reading says: "The state has anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: " Alternatively: "The realm faces trouble.

sentences.zh: 」五月，王淩、楚王彪等誅。

translations.literal: " Fifth month, Wang Ling, Prince of Chu Biao, and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month Wang Ling, Prince of Chu Biao, and others were put to death.

sentences.zh: 七月，皇后甄氏崩。

translations.literal: Seventh month, Empress Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Empress Zhen died.

sentences.zh: 嘉平三年五月甲寅，月犯距星。

translations.literal: Jiaping year 3, fifth month, day jiayin: the moon encroached on the margin star.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 3, fifth month, day jiayin: the moon crossed the margin star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「將軍死。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "A general dies.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "A general will die.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「為兵。

translations.literal: " One reading says: "There will be warfare.
translations.idiomatic: " Alternatively: "War follows.

sentences.zh: 」是月，王淩誅。

translations.literal: " That same month, Wang Ling was executed.
translations.idiomatic: " That very month Wang Ling was put to death.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，吳將硃然、硃異為寇，鎮東將軍諸葛誕破走之。

translations.literal: Year 4, third month, Wu generals Zhu Ran and Zhu Yi made incursions; General Who Pacifies the East Zhuge Dan defeated and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 4, third month: Wu generals Zhu Ran and Zhu Yi raided the border; General Who Pacifies the East Zhuge Dan routed them.

sentences.zh: 嘉平三年七月己巳，月犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Jiaping year 3, seventh month, day jisi: the moon encroached on Carriage Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 3, seventh month, day jisi: the moon crossed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 九月乙己，又犯。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day yiji, again encroached.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, day yiji: it crossed again.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月丁未，又犯鬼積屍。

translations.literal: Year 4, eleventh month, day dingwei, again encroached on Ghost's Heap of Corpses.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 4, eleventh month, day dingwei: it crossed Ghost's Heap of Corpses.

sentences.zh: 五年七月丙午，月又犯鬼西北星。

translations.literal: Year 5, seventh month, day bingwu, the moon again encroached on Ghost's northwest star.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 5, seventh month, day bingwu: the moon again crossed Ghost's northwest star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國有憂。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The state has anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The realm faces trouble.

sentences.zh: 」正元元年，李豐等誅，皇后張氏廢。

translations.literal: " Zhengyuan year 1, Li Feng and others were executed; Empress Zhang was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhengyuan 1: Li Feng and his allies were executed and Empress Zhang was deposed.

sentences.zh: 九月，帝廢為齊王。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the emperor was deposed as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor was deposed to become Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 齊王嘉平三年十月癸未，熒惑犯亢南星。

translations.literal: Prince of Qi, Jiaping year 3, tenth month, day guiwei: Sparkling Deluder encroached on the southern star of Neck.
translations.idiomatic: Under the deposed Prince of Qi, Jiaping 3, tenth month, day guiwei: Mars crossed Neck's southern star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大臣有亂。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Great ministers have rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Grand ministers will rebel.

sentences.zh: 」正元元年二月，李豐等謀亂誅。

translations.literal: " Zhengyuan year 1, second month, Li Feng and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhengyuan 1, second month: Li Feng and his co-conspirators were executed for treason.

sentences.zh: 嘉平三年十一月癸未，有星孛于營室，西行積九十日滅。

translations.literal: Jiaping year 3, eleventh month, day guiwei: a broom star appeared in Encampment, traveling west, accumulating ninety days before extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 3, eleventh month, day guiwei: a comet appeared in Encampment, moving westward for ninety days before it faded.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有兵喪。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "There is warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "War and mourning follow.

sentences.zh: 室為後宮，後宮且有亂。

translations.literal: Encampment is the rear palace; the rear palace will have rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Encampment governs the inner palace—and turmoil within the harem is at hand.

sentences.zh: 」四年二月丁酉，彗星見西方，在胃，長五六丈，色白，芒南指貫參，積二十日滅。

translations.literal: " Year 4, second month, day dingyou: a comet appeared in the west, in Stomach, five or six zhang long, white in color, its tail pointing south and piercing through Triaster, accumulating twenty days before extinction.
translations.idiomatic: " Jiaping 4, second month, day dingyou: a comet appeared in the west in Stomach, five or six fathoms long and white; its tail pointed south through Triaster and it remained visible for twenty days.

sentences.zh: 五年十一月，彗星又見軫，長五丈，在太微左執法西，東南指，積百九十日滅。

translations.literal: Year 5, eleventh month: a comet again appeared in Chariot Shaft, five zhang long, west of Supreme Subtlety's Left Enforcer, pointing southeast, accumulating one hundred ninety days before extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 5, eleventh month: another comet appeared in Chariot Shaft, five fathoms long, west of the Left Enforcer in Supreme Subtlety and pointing southeast; it lingered for one hundred ninety days.

sentences.zh: 按占，「胃，兗州之分，參白虎主兵，太微天子廷，執法為執政，孛彗為兵，除舊佈新之象。

translations.literal: Checking the prognostications: "Stomach is Yanzhou's allotted field; Triaster, the White Tiger, governs warfare; Supreme Subtlety is the Son of Heaven's court; the Enforcer is the chief minister; broom stars and comets presage warfare—signs of removing the old and spreading the new.
translations.idiomatic: Per the prognostications: "Stomach marks Yanzhou; Triaster, seat of the White Tiger, governs war; Supreme Subtlety is the imperial court and the Enforcer the chief minister; comets herald armies—the omen of sweeping away the old and installing the new.

sentences.zh: 」正元元年二月，李豐、豐弟兗州刺史翼、後父光祿大夫張緝等謀亂，皆誅，皇后亦廢。

translations.literal: " Zhengyuan year 1, second month, Li Feng, Feng's younger brother Yanzhou Inspector Yi, the empress's father Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Zhang Ji, and others plotted rebellion; all were executed, and the empress was also deposed.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhengyuan 1, second month: Li Feng, his brother Yanzhou inspector Yi, the empress's father Zhang Ji, and their co-conspirators were executed for treason, and the empress was deposed as well.

sentences.zh: 九月，帝廢為齊王，高貴鄉公代立。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the emperor was deposed as Prince of Qi; the Duke of Gaoguixiang succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor was deposed as Prince of Qi and the Duke of Gaoguixiang ascended the throne.

sentences.zh: 嘉平五年六月庚辰，月犯箕。

translations.literal: Jiaping year 5, sixth month, day gengchen: the moon encroached on Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 5, sixth month, day gengchen: the moon crossed Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「軍將死。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Army generals die.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "An army commander will die.

sentences.zh: 」正元元年正月，鎮東將軍母丘儉反，兵敗死。

translations.literal: " Zhengyuan year 1, first month, General Who Pacifies the East Guanqiu Jian rebelled, was defeated in battle and died.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhengyuan 1, first month: General Who Pacifies the East Guanqiu Jian rebelled, was defeated, and died.

sentences.zh: 嘉平五年六月戊午，太白犯角。

translations.literal: Jiaping year 5, sixth month, day wuwu: Great White encroached on Horn.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 5, sixth month, day wuwu: Venus crossed Horn.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「群臣謀不成。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The ministers' plot does not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Court conspiracies will fail.

sentences.zh: 」正元元年，李豐等謀泄，悉誅。

translations.literal: " Zhengyuan year 1, Li Feng and others' plot was leaked; all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhengyuan 1: Li Feng's conspiracy was exposed and all were executed.

sentences.zh: 嘉平五年七月，月犯井鉞。

translations.literal: Jiaping year 5, seventh month: the moon encroached on Well Axe.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 5, seventh month: the moon crossed Well Axe.

sentences.zh: 正元元年二月，李豐等誅。

translations.literal: Zhengyuan year 1, second month, Li Feng and others were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengyuan 1, second month: Li Feng and his allies were executed.

sentences.zh: 蜀將薑維攻隴西，車騎將軍郭淮討破之。

translations.literal: Shu general Jiang Wei attacked Longxi; General of Chariots and Cavalry Guo Huai attacked and defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Shu general Jiang Wei attacked Longxi; General of Chariots and Cavalry Guo Huai defeated him.

sentences.zh: 嘉平五年十一月癸酉，月犯東井距星。

translations.literal: Jiaping year 5, eleventh month, day guiyou: the moon encroached on Eastern Well's margin star.
translations.idiomatic: Jiaping 5, eleventh month, day guiyou: the moon crossed Eastern Well's margin star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「軍將死。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Army generals die.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "An army commander will die.

sentences.zh: 」至六年正月，鎮東將軍豫州刺史毋丘儉、前將軍揚州刺史文欽反，被誅。

translations.literal: " By the sixth year's first month, General Who Pacifies the East and Inspector of Yu Province Guanqiu Jian and Former General and Inspector of Yang Province Wen Qin rebelled and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: " By Jiaping 6, first month: General Who Pacifies the East and Yu provincial inspector Guanqiu Jian, together with Former General and Yang provincial inspector Wen Qin, rebelled and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 魏高貴鄉公正元元年十一月，有白氣出斗側，廣數丈，長竟天。

translations.literal: Wei, Duke of Gaoguixiang, Zhengyuan year 1, eleventh month: white vapor emerged from the side of Dipper, several zhang wide, stretching the length of the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wei emperor Cao Mao, Zhengyuan 1, eleventh month: white vapor rose beside the Dipper, several fathoms wide, streaking the length of the sky.

sentences.zh: 王肅曰：「蚩尤之旗也，東南其有亂乎！

translations.literal: Wang Su said: "This is the banner of Chiyou—is there rebellion in the southeast?
translations.idiomatic: Wang Su said: "That is Chiyou's banner—surely the southeast will erupt in rebellion!

sentences.zh: 」二年正月，毋丘儉等據淮南以叛，大將軍司馬師討平之。

translations.literal: " Year 2, first month, Guanqiu Jian and others held Huainan in rebellion; Grand General Sima Shi suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhengyuan 2, first month: Guanqiu Jian seized Huainan in revolt; Grand General Sima Shi crushed the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 案占，「蚩尤旗見，王者征伐四方。

translations.literal: Per astrological texts: "When Chiyou's banner appears, the king campaigns in all four directions.
translations.idiomatic: Per the prognostications: "When Chiyou's banner appears, the sovereign marches to war on every front.

sentences.zh: 」自後又征淮南，西平巴蜀。

translations.literal: " Afterwards there were again campaigns against Huainan and the pacification of Ba-Shu in the west.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereafter the court campaigned again in Huainan and pacified Ba and Shu in the west.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吳主孫亮五鳳元年，斗牛，吳、越分。

translations.literal: That year, Wu ruler Sun Liang's Wufeng year 1: Dipper-Ox—Wu and Yue's allotted field.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Sun Liang of Wu entered his Wufeng reign: the Dipper and Ox govern Wu and Yue's domain.

sentences.zh: 案占：「有兵喪，除舊佈新之象也。

translations.literal: Checking the prognostications: "There is warfare and mourning—the sign of removing the old and spreading the new.
translations.idiomatic: Per the prognostications: "War and mourning follow—the omen of sweeping away the old and installing the new.

sentences.zh: 」太平三年，孫綝盛兵圍宮，廢亮為會稽王，孫休代立，是其應也。

translations.literal: " Taiping year 3, Sun Chen massed troops and besieged the palace, deposed Liang as King of Kuaiji, and Sun Xiu succeeded him—this was its fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: " In Taiping 3, Sun Chen marched on the palace, deposed Sun Liang as King of Kuaiji, and installed Sun Xiu in his place—the omen fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 故國志又書于吳。

translations.literal: Therefore the Records of the Three Kingdoms also records it under Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Hence the Records of the Three Kingdoms places the entry under Wu as well.

sentences.zh: 由是淮南江東同揚州地，故于時變見吳、楚之分。

translations.literal: From this, Huainan and Jiangdong share Yang Province territory, so celestial anomalies of the time appeared in Wu and Chu's allotted fields.
translations.idiomatic: Because Huainan and Jiangdong both lay within Yang Province, the portents of that era clustered in the Wu and Chu domains.

sentences.zh: 則魏之淮南，多與吳同災，是以毋丘儉以孛為己應，遂起兵而敗，又其應也。

translations.literal: Thus Wei's Huainan often shared calamities with Wu; Guanqiu Jian took the broom star as his own omen, raised troops and was defeated—again its fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's Huainan and Wu often suffered the same omens; Guanqiu Jian read the comet as his personal sign, rose in revolt, and was crushed—yet another fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 後三年，即魏甘露二年，諸葛誕又反淮南，吳遣硃異救之。

translations.literal: Three years later, Wei Ganlu year 2, Zhuge Dan again rebelled in Huainan; Wu sent Zhu Yi to rescue him.
translations.idiomatic: Three years on—in Wei Ganlu 2—Zhuge Dan rebelled again in Huainan, and Wu dispatched Zhu Yi to his aid.

sentences.zh: 及城陷，誕眾吳兵死沒各數萬人，猶前長星之應也。

translations.literal: When the city fell, tens of thousands each among Dan's followers and Wu's soldiers died and perished—still the fulfillment of the earlier long star.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, tens of thousands on both sides—Dan's men and Wu's relief force—were killed, fulfilling the earlier comet's warning.

sentences.zh: 高貴鄉公正元二年二月戊午，熒惑犯東井北轅西頭第一星。

translations.literal: Duke of Gaoguixiang, Zhengyuan year 2, second month, day wuwu: Sparkling Deluder encroached on Eastern Well's northern shaft, the first star at its western end.
translations.idiomatic: Under Cao Mao, Zhengyuan 2, second month, day wuwu: Mars crossed the westernmost star at the northern yoke of Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「群臣有家坐罪者。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Among the ministers, some will have their clans punished for crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Ministers will see their families punished for capital offenses.

sentences.zh: 」甘露元年，諸葛誕族滅。

translations.literal: " Ganlu year 1, Zhuge Dan's clan was exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: " In Ganlu 1, Zhuge Dan's entire clan was annihilated.

sentences.zh: 吳孫亮太平元年九月壬辰，太白犯南斗，《吳志》所書也。

translations.literal: Wu, Sun Liang, Taiping year 1, ninth month, day renchen: Great White encroached on Southern Dipper—as recorded in the Wu Annals.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wu's Sun Liang, Taiping 1, ninth month, day renchen: Venus crossed Southern Dipper, according to the Wu Annals.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太白犯斗，國有兵，大臣有反者。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "When Great White encroaches on Dipper, the state has warfare and great ministers rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "When Venus strikes the Dipper, armies rise and high ministers turn traitor.

sentences.zh: 」其明年，諸葛誕反。

translations.literal: " The next year, Zhuge Dan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: " The following year Zhuge Dan rebelled.

sentences.zh: 又明年，孫琳廢亮，吳、魏並有兵事也。

translations.literal: The year after that, Sun Chen deposed Liang; Wu and Wei both had military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The year after that Sun Chen deposed Sun Liang, and both Wu and Wei were at war.

sentences.zh: 魏高貴鄉公甘露元年七月乙卯，熒惑犯井鉞。

translations.literal: Wei, Duke of Gaoguixiang, Ganlu year 1, seventh month, day yimao: Sparkling Deluder encroached on Well Axe.
translations.idiomatic: Under Wei emperor Cao Mao, Ganlu 1, seventh month, day yimao: Mars crossed Well Axe.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，月又犯鉞星。

translations.literal: Day renxu: the moon again encroached on the Axe star.
translations.idiomatic: On day renxu the moon crossed the Axe star again.

sentences.zh: 二年八月壬子，歲星犯井鉞。

translations.literal: Year 2, eighth month, day renzi: the Year Star encroached on Well Axe.
translations.idiomatic: Ganlu 2, eighth month, day renzi: Jupiter crossed Well Axe.

sentences.zh: 九月庚寅，歲星又逆行乘鉞星。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day gengyin: the Year Star again retrograded and mounted the Axe star.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, day gengyin: Jupiter retrograded and overtook the Axe star.

sentences.zh: 三年，諸葛誕夷滅。

translations.literal: Year 3, Zhuge Dan was exterminated to the last clan.
translations.idiomatic: In Ganlu 3 Zhuge Dan and his clan were annihilated.

sentences.zh: 甘露元年八月辛亥，月犯箕。

translations.literal: Ganlu year 1, eighth month, day xinhai: the moon encroached on Winnowing Basket.
translations.idiomatic: Ganlu 1, eighth month, day xinhai: the moon crossed Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「軍將死。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Army generals die.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "An army commander will die.

sentences.zh: 」九月丁巳，月犯東井。

translations.literal: " Ninth month, day dingsi: the moon encroached on Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: " Ninth month, day dingsi: the moon crossed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「軍將死。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Army generals die.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "A field commander will die.

sentences.zh: 」二年，諸葛誕誅。

translations.literal: " Year 2, Zhuge Dan was executed.
translations.idiomatic: " In Ganlu 2 Zhuge Dan was put to death.

sentences.zh: 甘露三年三月庚子，太白犯東井。

translations.literal: Ganlu year 3, third month, day gengzi: Great White encroached on Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Ganlu 3, third month, day gengzi: Venus crossed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國失政，大臣為亂。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The state loses good governance and great ministers make rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The realm falls into misrule and great ministers rise in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 」是夜，歲星又犯東井。

translations.literal: " That same night, the Year Star again encroached on Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: " That same night Jupiter crossed Eastern Well again.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵起。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Warfare rises.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Arms will be raised.

sentences.zh: 」至景元元年，高貴鄉公敗。

translations.literal: " By Jingyuan year 1, the Duke of Gaoguixiang was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: " By Jingyuan 1 the Duke of Gaoguixiang had fallen.

sentences.zh: 甘露三年八月壬辰，歲星犯輿鬼質星。

translations.literal: Ganlu year 3, eighth month, day renchen: the Year Star encroached on Carriage Ghost's Execution star.
translations.idiomatic: Ganlu 3, eighth month, day renchen: Jupiter crossed the Execution star in Carriage Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「斧質用，大臣誅。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Axe and block are employed; great ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The executioner's block will be used and great ministers will die.

sentences.zh: 」甘露四年四月甲申，歲星又犯輿鬼東南星。

translations.literal: " Ganlu year 4, fourth month, day jiashen: the Year Star again encroached on Carriage Ghost's southeastern star.
translations.idiomatic: " Ganlu 4, fourth month, day jiashen: Jupiter again crossed the southeastern star of Carriage Ghost.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「鬼東南星主兵。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Ghost's southeastern star governs warfare.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The southeastern star of Ghost presides over war.

sentences.zh: 木入鬼，大臣誅。

translations.literal: Wood enters Ghost; great ministers are executed.
translations.idiomatic: When Jupiter enters Ghost, great ministers are put to death.

sentences.zh: 」景元元年，高貴鄉公敗，殺尚書王經。

translations.literal: " Jingyuan year 1, the Duke of Gaoguixiang was defeated and Master of Writing Wang Jing was killed.
translations.idiomatic: " In Jingyuan 1 the Duke of Gaoguixiang was overthrown and Master of Writing Wang Jing was executed.

sentences.zh: 甘露四年十月丁丑，客星見太微中，轉東南行，曆軫宿，積七日滅。

translations.literal: Ganlu year 4, tenth month, day dingchou: a guest star appeared within Supreme Subtlety, turned and traveled southeast, passing through Chariot Shaft lodge, accumulating seven days before extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Ganlu 4, tenth month, day dingchou: a guest star appeared in Supreme Subtlety, drifted southeast through Chariot Shaft, and vanished after seven days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「客星出太微，有兵喪。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "When a guest star emerges from Supreme Subtlety, there is warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "A guest star rising from Supreme Subtlety brings war and mourning.

sentences.zh: 」景元元年，高貴鄉公被害。

translations.literal: " Jingyuan year 1, the Duke of Gaoguixiang was slain.
translations.idiomatic: " In Jingyuan 1 the Duke of Gaoguixiang was murdered.

sentences.zh: 景元二年四月，熒惑入太微，犯右執法。

translations.literal: Jingyuan year 2, fourth month: Sparkling Deluder entered Supreme Subtlety and encroached on the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan 2, fourth month: Mars entered Supreme Subtlety and crossed the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「人主有大憂。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The ruler has great anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The sovereign will face grave peril.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「大臣憂。

translations.literal: " It also says: "Great ministers have anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: " It adds: "Great ministers will suffer calamity.

sentences.zh: 」後四年，鄧艾、鐘會皆夷滅。

translations.literal: " Four years later, Deng Ai and Zhong Hui were both exterminated to the last clan.
translations.idiomatic: " Four years on Deng Ai and Zhong Hui were both annihilated, clans and all.

sentences.zh: 五年，帝遜位。

translations.literal: Year 5, the emperor abdicated.
translations.idiomatic: In Jingyuan 5 the emperor abdicated the throne.

sentences.zh: 景元三年十一月壬寅，彗星見亢，色白，長五寸，轉北行，積四十五日滅。

translations.literal: Jingyuan year 3, eleventh month, day renyin: a comet appeared at Neck, white in color, five cun long, turned and traveled north, accumulating forty-five days before extinction.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan 3, eleventh month, day renyin: a white comet five inches long appeared at Neck, swung northward, and faded after forty-five days.

sentences.zh: 占為兵喪。

translations.literal: Prognostication takes it as warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads war and mourning.

sentences.zh: 一曰：「彗見亢，天子失德。

translations.literal: One account says: "When a comet appears at Neck, the Son of Heaven loses virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Another text says: "A comet at Neck means the sovereign has lost the Mandate.

sentences.zh: 」四年，鐘會、鄧艾伐蜀克之。

translations.literal: " Year 4, Zhong Hui and Deng Ai attacked Shu and conquered it.
translations.idiomatic: " In Jingyuan 4 Zhong Hui and Deng Ai invaded Shu and took the kingdom.

sentences.zh: 會、艾反亂，皆誅。

translations.literal: Hui and Ai rebelled in disorder; both were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Both men then rebelled and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 魏遜天下。

translations.literal: Wei yielded the empire.
translations.idiomatic: Wei surrendered the realm.

sentences.zh: 景元四年六月，大流星二，並如斗，見西方，分流南北，光照隆隆有聲。

translations.literal: Jingyuan year 4, sixth month: two great meteors, each like the Dipper, appeared in the west, splitting flows north and south; their light rumbled thunderously with sound.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan 4, sixth month: two great bolides, each as bright as the Dipper, blazed in the west and split north and south; their glare rolled like thunder.

sentences.zh: 案占，流星為貴使，大者使大。

translations.literal: Checking the prognostications: meteors signify noble envoys; large ones signify great envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Per the prognostications, meteors represent high emissaries—the greater the fireball, the greater the envoy.

sentences.zh: 是年，鐘、鄧克蜀，二星蓋二帥之象。

translations.literal: That year, Zhong and Deng conquered Shu—the two stars were surely the image of two commanders.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhong Hui and Deng Ai conquered Shu—the twin meteors plainly foreshadowed the two generals.

sentences.zh: 二帥相背，又分流南北之應。

translations.literal: The two commanders turned against each other—again the fulfillment of splitting flows north and south.
translations.idiomatic: The two commanders turned on each other, matching the omen of the streams dividing north and south.

sentences.zh: 鐘會既叛，三軍憤怒，隆隆有聲，兵將怒之征也。

translations.literal: Once Zhong Hui rebelled, the three armies were enraged; the thunderous rumbling was the sign of soldiers and generals' anger.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhong Hui rebelled the armies seethed with rage—the thunderous glare was the sign of mutinous soldiery.

sentences.zh: 景元四年十月，歲星守房。

translations.literal: Jingyuan year 4, tenth month: the Year Star guarded Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: Jingyuan 4, tenth month: Jupiter held station in Encampment.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「將相有憂。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Generals and chancellors have anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Generals and ministers will face disaster.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「有大赦。

translations.literal: " One account says: "There is a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: " Another reading says: "A great amnesty will follow.

sentences.zh: 」明年正月，太尉鄧艾、司徒鐘會並誅滅，特赦益土。

translations.literal: " The next year, first month, Grand Commandant Deng Ai and Minister over the Masses Zhong Hui were both executed and exterminated; a special amnesty was granted for Yi territory.
translations.idiomatic: " The following first month Grand Commandant Deng Ai and Minister over the Masses Zhong Hui were both killed and their clans destroyed, while a special amnesty was proclaimed in the conquered lands of Yi.

sentences.zh: 咸熙二年秋，又大赦。

translations.literal: Xianxi year 2, autumn: there was again a great amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianxi 2, autumn, the court proclaimed another great amnesty.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝泰始四年正月丙戌，彗星見軫，青白色，西北行，又轉東行。

translations.literal: Jin Emperor Wu, Taishi year 4, first month, day bingxu: a comet appeared in Chariot Shaft, greenish-white, traveling northwest, then turning to travel east.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Jin, Taishi 4, first month, day bingxu: a greenish-white comet appeared in Chariot Shaft, moving northwest before swinging eastward.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為兵喪。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "It signifies warfare and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "War and mourning follow.

sentences.zh: 軫又楚分也。

translations.literal: Chariot Shaft is also Chu's allotted field.
translations.idiomatic: Chariot Shaft also marks Chu's domain.

sentences.zh: 」三月，皇太后王氏崩。

translations.literal: " Third month, Empress Dowager Lady Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: " In the third month Empress Dowager Wang passed away.

sentences.zh: 十月，吳將施績寇江夏，萬彧寇襄陽，後將軍田璋、荊州刺史胡烈等破卻之。

translations.literal: Tenth month, Wu generals Shi Ji raided Jiangxia and Wan Yu raided Xiangyang; Rear General Tian Zhang, Jing Province Inspector Hu Lie, and others defeated and repelled them.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Wu generals Shi Ji attacked Jiangxia and Wan Yu attacked Xiangyang; Rear General Tian Zhang, Jing provincial inspector Hu Lie, and others drove them back.

sentences.zh: 泰始四年七月，星隕如雨，皆西流。

translations.literal: Taishi year 4, seventh month: stars fell like rain, all flowing westward.
translations.idiomatic: Taishi 4, seventh month: stars showered down like rain, all streaking westward.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「星隕為民叛，西流，吳民歸晉之象也。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Falling stars signify the people's rebellion; flowing westward is the image of Wu's people returning to Jin.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "A starfall marks popular defection; a westward drift foretells Wu's people submitting to Jin.

sentences.zh: 」二年，吳夏口督孫秀率部曲二千餘人來降。

translations.literal: " Two years later, Wu's Xiakou supervisor Sun Xiu led more than two thousand of his personal troops in surrender.
translations.idiomatic: " Two years on Wu's Xiakou garrison commander Sun Xiu brought more than two thousand of his retainers over in surrender.

sentences.zh: 泰始五年九月，有星孛于紫宮，占如上。

translations.literal: Taishi year 5, ninth month: a broom star appeared at Purple Palace; the prognostication is as above.
translations.idiomatic: Taishi 5, ninth month: a comet appeared in Purple Palace—the reading is as given above.

sentences.zh: 紫宮，天子內宮。

translations.literal: Purple Palace is the Son of Heaven's inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: Purple Palace is the sovereign's inner court.

sentences.zh: 十年，武元楊皇后崩。

translations.literal: Year 10, Empress Wu Yuan Lady Yang died.
translations.idiomatic: In Taishi 10 Empress Yang—the Wu Yuan empress—died.

sentences.zh: 泰始十年十二月，有星孛於軫。

translations.literal: Taishi year 10, twelfth month: a broom star appeared at Chariot Shaft.
translations.idiomatic: Taishi 10, twelfth month: a comet appeared in Chariot Shaft.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下兵起。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Warfare rises throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "War will erupt across the empire.

sentences.zh: 軫又楚分也。

translations.literal: Chariot Shaft is also Chu's allotted field.
translations.idiomatic: Chariot Shaft also marks Chu's domain.

sentences.zh: 」咸寧二年六月，星孛於氐。

translations.literal: " Xianning year 2, sixth month: a broom star appeared at Root.
translations.idiomatic: " In Xianning 2, sixth month, a comet appeared at Root.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子失德易政。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The Son of Heaven loses virtue and the regime changes.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The sovereign forfeits virtue and the throne changes hands.

sentences.zh: 氐又兗州分。

translations.literal: Root is also Yanzhou's allotted field.
translations.idiomatic: Root also marks Yanzhou's domain.

sentences.zh: 」七月，星孛大角。

translations.literal: " Seventh month: a broom star appeared at Great Horn.
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventh month a comet appeared at Great Horn.

sentences.zh: 大角為帝坐。

translations.literal: Great Horn is the Emperor's Seat.
translations.idiomatic: Great Horn is the throne star of the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 八月，星孛太微，至翼、北斗、三台。

translations.literal: Eighth month: a broom star appeared at Supreme Subtlety, reaching Wings, Northern Dipper, and Three Steps.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month a comet appeared in Supreme Subtlety and passed through Wings, the Northern Dipper, and the Three Steps.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太微天子廷，大人惡之。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Supreme Subtlety is the Son of Heaven's court; great men dread it.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Supreme Subtlety is the imperial court—great men will suffer for it.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「有徙王。

translations.literal: " One account says: "There will be a transferred king.
translations.idiomatic: " Another reading says: "A deposed prince will be moved.

sentences.zh: 翼又楚分也。

translations.literal: Wings is also Chu's allotted field.
translations.idiomatic: Wings also marks Chu's domain.

sentences.zh: 」「北斗主殺罰，三台為三公。

translations.literal: " "Northern Dipper governs killing and punishment; Three Steps are the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: " "The Northern Dipper presides over execution and judgment; the Three Steps represent the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 」三年，星孛於胃。

translations.literal: " Year 3: a broom star appeared at Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: " In Xianning 3 a comet appeared at Stomach.

sentences.zh: 胃，徐州分。

translations.literal: Stomach is Xuzhou's allotted field.
translations.idiomatic: Stomach marks Xuzhou's domain.

sentences.zh: 四月，星孛女禦。

translations.literal: Fourth month: a broom star appeared at Female Charioteer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month a comet appeared at Female Charioteer.

sentences.zh: 女禦為後宮。

translations.literal: Female Charioteer is the rear palace.
translations.idiomatic: Female Charioteer governs the inner harem.

sentences.zh: 五月，又孛於東方。

translations.literal: Fifth month: a broom star again appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month another comet appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 七月，星孛紫宮。

translations.literal: Seventh month: a broom star appeared at Purple Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month a comet appeared in Purple Palace.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下易主。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "The realm changes its ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "The empire will change hands.

sentences.zh: 」五年三月，星孛于柳。

translations.literal: " Year 5, third month: a broom star appeared at Willow.
translations.idiomatic: " In Xianning 5, third month, a comet appeared at Willow.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「外臣陵主。

translations.literal: Prognostication says: "Outer ministers encroach upon the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Prognostication reads: "Outer vassals will overpower their lord.

sentences.zh: 柳又三河分也。

translations.literal: Willow is also the Three Rivers' allotted field.
translations.idiomatic: Willow also marks the Three Rivers domain.

sentences.zh: 大角、太微、紫宮、女禦，並為王者。

translations.literal: Great Horn, Supreme Subtlety, Purple Palace, and Female Charioteer all represent the kingly ruler.
translations.idiomatic: Great Horn, Supreme Subtlety, Purple Palace, and Female Charioteer all stand for royal power.

sentences.zh: 」明年吳亡，是其應也。

translations.literal: " The next year Wu perished—this was its fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: " The following year Wu fell—the omen fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 孛主兵喪，征吳之役，三河、徐、兗之兵悉出，交戰于吳、楚之地。

translations.literal: Broom stars govern warfare and mourning; in the campaign against Wu, armies of the Three Rivers, Xu, and Yan all marched out and joined battle in Wu and Chu territory.
translations.idiomatic: Comets presage war and death; in the conquest of Wu, forces from the Three Rivers, Xu, and Yan all took the field and clashed in the Wu-Chu heartland.

sentences.zh: 吳丞相都督以下，梟戮十數，偏裨行陣之徒，馘斬萬計，皆其征也。

translations.literal: Among Wu, from chancellors and area commanders downward, more than ten were decapitated and displayed; among lieutenants and rank-and-file in the battle lines, those beheaded and killed numbered in the tens of thousands—all signs of it.
translations.idiomatic: More than a dozen Wu chancellors and commanders were executed and exposed; lieutenants and common soldiers fell by the tens of thousands—all of it the comet's doing.

sentences.zh: 《春秋》星孛北方，則齊、魯、晉、鄭、陳、宋、莒之君，並受殺亂之禍。

translations.literal: In the Spring and Autumn Annals, when a broom star appeared in the north, the rulers of Qi, Lu, Jin, Zheng, Chen, Song, and Ju all suffered the calamity of slaughter and disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Annals record that when a comet appeared in the north, the rulers of Qi, Lu, Jin, Zheng, Chen, Song, and Ju all met violent ruin.

sentences.zh: 星孛東方，則楚滅陳，三家、田氏分篡齊、晉。

translations.literal: When a broom star appeared in the east, Chu destroyed Chen, and the Three Families and the Tian clan partitioned and usurped Qi and Jin.
translations.idiomatic: An eastern comet foretold Chu destroying Chen and the great houses of Jin and Qi carving up their states.

sentences.zh: 漢文帝末，星孛西方，後吳、楚七國誅滅。

translations.literal: At the end of Emperor Wen of Han, a broom star appeared in the west; afterward the seven kingdoms of Wu and Chu were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: Near the end of Emperor Wen's reign a comet appeared in the west; soon after the seven kingdoms of Wu and Chu were crushed.

sentences.zh: 案泰始末至太康初，災異數見，而晉氏隆盛，吳實滅，天變在吳可知矣。

translations.literal: Examined: from the end of Taishi to the beginning of Taikang, calamities and anomalies appeared repeatedly, yet the Jin clan flourished and Wu was truly destroyed—heaven's changes targeted Wu, as can be known.
translations.idiomatic: From late Taishi through early Taikang, omens multiplied even as Jin rose and Wu fell—clear proof that heaven's warnings were aimed at Wu, not Jin.

sentences.zh: 昔漢三年，星孛大角，項籍以亡，漢氏無事，此項氏主命故也。

translations.literal: Formerly in Han year 3, a comet baleful at Great Horn—Xiang Yu perished thereby while the Han house was unharmed; this was because Great Horn was the star of Xiang's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: In Han year 3 a comet struck Great Horn: Xiang Yu fell while the Han house stood untouched, for Great Horn governed Xiang's fate.

sentences.zh: 吳、晉之時，天下橫分，大角孛而吳亡，是與項氏同事。

translations.literal: In the age of Wu and Jin, the realm was split across; Great Horn was baleful and Wu perished—this is the same affair as the Xiang clan.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu and Jin divided the realm, a comet at Great Horn preceded Wu's fall—the same pattern as Xiang Yu's doom.

sentences.zh: 後學皆以咸甯災為晉室，非也。

translations.literal: Later scholars all take the Xianning calamities as aimed at the Jin house—this is wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Later scholars misread the Xianning omens as warnings to Jin; they are mistaken.
